egress.terms: 'Download volume Unlimited' claimed on all tiers including free. BUT the vendor's published conditions reserve the right to 'Disable direct linking for accounts exceeding bandwidth thresholds' — an unpublished, discretionary egress wall. Hotlinking is blocked by the vendor's own rule: 'Hotlinking is strictly prohibited for all files hosted on our platform.'.

reliability_note: The vendor's published conditions disclaim everything: 'UpZur is not responsible for: User content loss or unavailability … Future service reliability guarantees.' Hotlinking is blocked by the vendor's own rule, so the serving workload sits outside the published allocation, with an unpublished enforcement threshold — this is the definition of an unquantified egress trap.
